title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 077
review_goal: Differentiate pinwheel, playlist, and plugin variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Four pinwheel blades around one small center hub with one straight stick dropping below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple four blade pinwheel mounted on a straight stick.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the denser folded pinwheel when the blade center should look more layered and compact.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the blade shape simple and centered above one straight stick.

items.depicts_observation: Four folded pinwheel blades around one dense center hub with one straight stick below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a pinwheel whose blades bunch closer into a denser folded center.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler pinwheel when the blade center should stay open and less layered.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot packs the blades tighter around the hub and makes the middle look denser than the basic pinwheel.

items.depicts_observation: Three horizontal playlist lines with one circular play button at the lower right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a playlist list view paired with one round play button at the corner.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the playlist with the extra right side play panel when the upper right control should look boxed in.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows list lines on the left and one clear round play button anchored at the lower right.

items.depicts_observation: Three horizontal playlist lines with one boxed play panel at the upper right and one round play button below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants playlist lines paired with a more structured right side play control area.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler playlist when the right side should show only one round play button with no boxed panel above.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a second boxed play area at the upper right above the lower round play button.

items.depicts_observation: Symmetrical plug block with two short prongs above and one short connector tab below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a centered plug or module block with matching left and right sides.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the angled connector piece when the plug head should lean and the cable should enter from one side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the plugin body centered and balanced with two matching top prongs.
